notes: Partition verified: s001-s015 and t001-t031 each occur exactly once; every head is a member of its array.

s006 tau-omega-nu is correctly read as the substantival article of the participle, not as an attributive article governing metathesin across an interposed genitive (rule 57): it is GPN and metathesin is ASF, so no agreement is possible. The projection supplies no article for metathesin at all, which is why the supplied *the* is a rule 51 anarthrous helper on the noun rather than an article's determiner.

The one genuinely open call is *more* (t006): kept with hapax as part of the English idiom *once more* rather than read as a discontinuous second word of eti. The unit's note already names the competing reading, satisfying rule 16; both readings remain defensible and a later chapter meeting Eti hapax should follow whichever it records.
